title: Young Boy Kent with Range Rider Toy in Garden, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot of a blonde toddler identified in the lower front margin as 'Kent - 3 1/2 yrs.' Kent stands in a garden bed flanked by leafy plants and daylily foliage, wearing a short-sleeved collared shirt, belted shorts, and dark shoes. He clutches a toy cowboy pistol and holster labeled 'RANGE RIDER', a popular Western television series starring Jock Mahoney that aired between 1951 and 1953, capturing mid-century American youth culture and the nationwide craze for cowboy gear.
